gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 1b/2 Trial of PVSRIPO in Combination With Atezolizumab in Recurrent WHO Grade IV Malignant Glioma
Patients must have a recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma based on imaging studies

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named only in keywords; population is WHO grade IV malignant glioma with no IDH requirement, coded as historical glioblastoma per manual 1.1 (grade 4 glioma); could instead be high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: Atezolizumab infusions at a dose of 1200 mg every three weeks for up to two years.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Combination of PVSRIPO and Atezolizumab for Adults With Recurrent Malignant Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Atezolizumab infusions at a dose of 1200 mg every three weeks for up to two years.

coder_notes: MGMT status appears only in exclusion criteria as prior-chemotherapy history, not as an entry biomarker. Atezolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (PVSRIPO is an oncolytic virus), so experimental_monotherapy per manual worked example; regimen is combination because PVSRIPO is also antitumour. Registry lists conditions as Malignant Glioma only.
